provenance.source: Auto Trader UK, Three new Alpine A110s revealed at the 2018 Geneva Motor Show (March 2018)
provenance.notes: The A110 GT4, a race version of the A110 launched in 2017 prepared by Signatech, was presented at Geneva in March 2018 with the first customer cars racing that year.

provenance.source: Alpine Cars UK, Competition: A110 GT4 Evo
provenance.notes: Alpine and Signatech developed the A110 GT4 Evo, an update of the same car.

provenance.source: Racecar Engineering, Alpine reveals the A110 GT4+ (March 2025)
provenance.notes: The A110 GT4+ of 2025 is an evolution of the A110 GT4 Evo (2022), with an upgrade kit for existing A110 GT4 and GT4 Evo cars. The Evo and the GT4+ are updates of the same race car and stay in this generation, which is still on sale.

External ids of the make and the model. The model is linked to the item of the A110 launched in 2017; the original A110 of 1961 has its own item (Q741857). The generation id gen2 leaves gen1 for that first A110.
